decisions.reason: Naval vessel lighting serves a robust specialist niche with long defence procurement cycles and rising demand, so results are unlikely to fall below aspirations and slack allows the firm to carry it.

The spring-balanced desk lamp still supports the ergonomic workplace portfolio with its own page, and no evident shortfall would trigger problemistic search, though small desk lamps are a more peripheral line.
The second-generation general interior luminaire is a core-business refresh in the established segment where released resources are being concentrated, making withdrawal unlikely.
Dropping the related HMI searchlight shows the marine searchlight segment is under review, which raises the risk, but the remaining line complements the naval offering and has no clear shortfall yet.
